credibility.reason: The intervention and receiver-response contracts pass, but the preregistered finite conflict verdict fails closed because the selected plans are horizon-censored and sometimes have multiple occupancy intervals.

selected_plan_conflict_mitigation_order_.reason: All selected 3 s plans remain in C at the right horizon boundary; separated and overlap also contain two observed occupancy intervals. The preregistered fail-closed rule therefore returns c=null.

raw_final_forward_progress_obeys_the_exp.reason: Overlap advances 12.286 m while boundary advances 11.168 m under the same selected mode; raw progress is auxiliary and cannot replace finite c.

real_world_safety_or_general_hugsim_cred.reason: The experiment has no matched real source RGB, independent lane truth, externally qualified footprint truth or real outcome reference.

receiver_response_detectable.expected: Preregistered input changes should produce plan changes larger than reset variation if they reach the receiver.
receiver_response_detectable.observed: Adjacent-condition plan differences are 0.234 m and 1.118 m versus a 0.0000305 m repeat envelope.
receiver_response_detectable.implication: The rendered phase intervention reaches this fixed SparseDrive receiver and produces a distinguishable response; response correctness is not established.

planning_horizon_conflict_region_mismatc.expected: The finite-c verdict requires one complete, uncensored occupancy interval for each planned path.
planning_horizon_conflict_region_mismatc.observed: All three plans are right-censored at 3 s; two conditions also show multiple observed intervals.
planning_horizon_conflict_region_mismatc.implication: This elongated near-opposing C is incompatible with a finite-c verdict from SparseDrive's fixed 3 s horizon; the tool correctly fails closed.

auxiliary_progress_nonmonotonic.expected: Under the same planning mode, stronger public conflict should not be interpreted as more conservative solely from an assumed progress ordering.
auxiliary_progress_nonmonotonic.observed: Boundary has the least final progress; overlap advances 1.118 m farther than boundary.
auxiliary_progress_nonmonotonic.implication: The response is not captured by a simple slowing proxy, but the unavailable primary conflict verdict prevents attribution to an AD defect or simulator defect.

strongest_allowed_claim: Within the preregistered scene-0041 phase grid, HUGSIM preserves the designed public-path occupancy order and transports it consistently into RGB; fixed SparseDrive produces repeat-distinguishable but non-monotonic planning changes. The fixed 3 s plan horizon cannot support the preregistered finite conflict-mitigation verdict for this elongated near-opposing conflict region.
